description: Mapping of FLAVORED_ITEM names from Machines.json to their gameIds and display names. These items change their name based on input (e.g., 'Blueberry Wine', 'Hot Pepper Jelly').

Juice.notes: Made from vegetables or fruits in kegs

Jelly.notes: Made from fruits in preserves jars

Pickle.notes: Made from vegetables in preserves jars

AgedRoe.notes: Made from roe in preserves jars

Honey.notes: Made in bee houses (can be flavored with nearby flowers)

DriedFruit.notes: 1.6+ exclusive. Made from 5 fruits in dehydrators.

DriedMushroom.notes: 1.6+ exclusive. Made from 5 mushrooms in dehydrators.

SmokedFish.notes: 1.6+ exclusive. Made from fish in fish smokers.
